ORDER This is first bail application filed on behalf of applicant under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (Section 439 of Cr.P.C.).
2.

The applicant is in jail since 09.04.2025 in connection with Crime No.07/2024 registered at P.S.
Raipura, District- Panna for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 409, 467, 468 of IPC.
3. Prosecution story in brief is that applicant defrauded complainants of an amount of Rs.12,94,000/-.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that earlier applicant was released on anticipatory bail.
But as he could not deposit the amount.
Therefore, he surrendered before the trial Court and he is in jail since 09.04.2025.
After investigation, charge sheet has been filed.
Custodial interrogation of applicant is not required.

It is also urged that the applicant is NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:43198 2 MCRC-33202-2025 ready to deposit Rs.10,00,000/- before the trial Court.
The trial of the case will take considerable time.
Therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant be released on bail pending the trial.

6. Having regard to factual matrix of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, bail application under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

7. Hence, in view of submissions of learned counsel for the applicant, it is directed that applicant be released on bail subject to depositing Rs.10,00,000/- (Rupees Ten Lacs) before the trial Court and on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.15,000/- (Rupees Fifteen Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
8. This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
9. Soft copy of this bail order be sent immediately/forthwith to applicant through concerned jail Superintendent.
